definitions.definition: Individually identifiable health information that is transmitted or maintained in any form or medium by a covered entity or its business associate, subject to regulatory exclusions in 45 CFR Parts 160/164.
definitions.note: Paraphrase for operational use — consult CFR for authoritative text. Not an Enigma invention.

definitions.definition: PHI that is transmitted by electronic media or maintained in electronic media.

Any information, including genetic information, whether oral or recorded in any form or medium, that relates to the past, present, or future physical or mental health or condition of an individual; the provision of health care to an individual; or the past, present, or future payment for the provision of health care to an individual.
Categories of identifiers that must be removed for Safe Harbor de-identification under 45 CFR 164.514(b)(2) and HHS guidance.
definitions.note: DEIDENTIFICATION_SAFE_HARBOR_IDENTIFIER categories are relevant to de-identification. They are NOT equivalent to the complete definition of PHI.

definitions.definition: Enigma operational sensitivity/context indicating health-related content that may warrant additional Enigma controls. Distinct from regulatory PHI.
definitions.note: Do not present as a legal HIPAA classification.

definitions.definition: Enigma vault replacement of sensitive spans with {{TOK_*}} placeholders before model execution.
definitions.note: Not a HIPAA mandate; may help satisfy protection/transmission controls depending on context.

definitions.definition: Gateway action that restores vault tokens after Enigma release policy determines release conditions are satisfied.
definitions.note: HIPAA does not itself authorize detokenization. Enigma release policy decides; gateway enforces.
